preconditions.description: The number of chairs n must be between 2 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= int(stdin.split()[1]) <= int(stdin.split()[0]) and 1 <= int(stdin.split()[2]) <= int(stdin.split()[0]) and int(stdin.split()[1]) != int(stdin.split()[2])
preconditions.description: Starting chair s and ending chair e must be distinct and within the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdin.split()[3:3 + int(stdin.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: Each chair coordinate xi must be between 1 and 10^9 inclusive, and strictly increasing.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) <= 10**9 for a in stdin.split()[3 + int(stdin.split()[0]):3 + 2 * int(stdin.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: Each landing time ai (when large) must be between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(b) <= 10**9 for b in stdin.split()[3 + 2 * int(stdin.split()[0]):3 + 3 * int(stdin.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: Each landing time bi (when small) must be between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(c) <= 10**9 for c in stdin.split()[3 + 3 * int(stdin.split()[0]):3 + 4 * int(stdin.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: Each takeoff time ci (when small) must be between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(d) <= 10**9 for d in stdin.split()[3 + 4 * int(stdin.split()[0]):3 + 5 * int(stdin.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: Each takeoff time di (when large) must be between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must be a non-negative integer representing the minimum time.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n for i in range(1, n + 1)) and all(1 <= j <= n for j in range(1, n + 1)) and all(i != j for i in range(1, n + 1) for j in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The solution must visit each chair exactly once, starting at s and ending at e.

postconditions.expression: stdout == min(total_time for path in permutations(range(1, n + 1)) if path[0] == s and path[-1] == e for total_time in [sum(abs(x[path[i]] - x[path[i + 1]]) + (c[path[i]] + b[path[i + 1]]) if path[i + 1] < path[i] else (d[path[i]] + a[path[i + 1]]) for i in range(len(path) - 1))])
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum total time to traverse all chairs exactly once, starting at s and ending at e, respecting the jump rules and size constraints.
